artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Sanctae Sedis 36 (1903-1904), pp. 257-268. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. The catalog index dates Hoc mandatum 27 June 1897; this web transcription and the ASS 36 printing date it sexto Kalendas Iunias 1897 (27 May). The disagreement is retained. The web text ends with the papal subscription and does not reproduce all the additional printed subscriptions.
